name: bipixie
description: A skill that helps Claude read a Power BI semantic model with BI Pixie, paired with the BI Pixie connector.

tenant_id.title: Microsoft Entra tenant ID
tenant_id.description: Claude Code only. The ID of the Microsoft Entra tenant you sign in to Power BI with. Claude in the browser and Claude Desktop use the hosted BI Pixie connector and do not need it.

workspace_name.title: BI Pixie workspace
workspace_name.description: Claude Code only. The name of the Power BI workspace that holds your BI Pixie Dashboard semantic model. With the BI Pixie workload, it is the Fabric workspace where you created the BI Pixie item.

dataset_name.title: BI Pixie Dashboard semantic model
dataset_name.description: Claude Code only. The name of your BI Pixie Dashboard semantic model, if you renamed it.

api_app_id.title: BI Pixie API application ID
api_app_id.description: Claude Code only, and optional. It lets the local server manage BI Pixie for you, such as running a benchmark. The value for BI Pixie Cloud and the BI Pixie workload is in the plugin's README. Left empty, the local server still answers questions about your data.
